headline: Rachika Nayar’s Heaven Come Crashing is an instrumental epic of desperate longing
summary: Rachika Nayar's new album, "Heaven Come Crashing," features a surprising shift with massive drum and bass beats. This marks a departure from her previous album, which had no percussion. The record is described as an instrumental epic conveying desperate longing.

headline: Fender’s CEO seems to think your bandmates are just analog AI
summary: Fender CEO Edward "Bud" Cole made controversial remarks equating bandmates to "analog AI." These comments, initially from a May interview, recently gained widespread attention. The statements add to Fender's ongoing negative public relations issues.

headline: Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170
summary: Microsoft has announced substantial price increases for Xbox consoles in the EU and UK. Prices will rise by up to €200 or £170, depending on the specific model. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is confirmed to be affected by these changes.

headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight is hosting a back-to-school sale, offering up to $90 off its smart calendars. The sale is active from August 2nd through August 9th. These shared calendars help families manage busy schedules and responsibilities during the school year.

headline: Wicked Star Ariana Grande to Take a 'Step Back From Visibility' Amid 'Endless, Ongoing Public Scrutiny'
summary: Ariana Grande will take a "step back from visibility" following her Eternal Sunshine tour. This decision comes amidst "endless, ongoing public scrutiny." She has also exited the West End musical "Sunday in the Park with George."

headline: Tom Holland Says Spider-Man 5 Is 'Unclear,' Teases He Knows When Miles Morales Will Join the MCU
summary: Tom Holland states that details regarding "Spider-Man 5" are currently "unclear." The actor, known for playing Peter Parker, hinted that he knows when Miles Morales will join the MCU. This news comes amidst anticipation for the future of the Spider-Man franchise.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Comes Close to Passing Avengers: Endgame With Second Biggest Box Office Debut of All Time at $927 Million Globally
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" achieved an estimated $927 million at the global box office during its opening weekend. This makes it the second-biggest box office debut ever, narrowly missing "Avengers: Endgame." The film capitalized on the combined appeal of Tom Holland and the MCU.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection, Saros, Death Stranding 2, and More
summary: This article highlights the top gaming deals available today. Featured sales include "Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection," "Saros," and "Death Stranding 2." Shoppers can find discounts on a variety of popular and upcoming titles.

headline: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
summary: Two crew members died after a collision between two firefighting helicopters in Greece. The fatalities include one Danish and one Greek national. A British pilot and another Greek crew member survived the incident.

headline: Burnham pledges to be 'relentless' in curbing small boat crossings
summary: Prime Minister Burnham vows to be "relentless" in stopping small boat crossings into the UK. He emphasized the need for increased enforcement measures. Burnham also suggested exploring more safe routes for entry into the UK.

headline: Ariana Grande pulls out of musical for break from 'endless' scrutiny
summary: US singer Ariana Grande, 33, is stepping back from public visibility after her world tour. She has withdrawn from an upcoming West End musical. Her representative cited "endless" public scrutiny as the reason for this break.

headline: Prolonged drought could cause shortage of some foods, farmers' union head says
summary: NFU president Tom Bradshaw warns that prolonged drought could lead to shortages of certain foods. He called on the government to take action against extreme weather impacting the UK's food supply. Farmers are concerned about the agricultural sector's resilience.
